name: Mussels with Romano Everything Cheese Straws

ingredients.name: mussels in a white wine sauce

instructions.primary_message: Roll out puff pastry on a lightly floured surface until it is 10 x 12-inches.
Place egg and 1 tbsp water in a small bowl, then beat with a whisk or fork. Brush surface of pastry with the egg mixture.
Sprinkle the sheet evenly with cheese and Everything seasoning. Using a rolling pin, gently press the cheese and seasoning into the puff pastry.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup shredded cheese, Italian blend
1 ½ tbsp Everything bagel seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Using a floured knife or pizza cutter, cut each strip into 1-inch wide strips. Twist each strip and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, about 1-inch apart.
Bake until lightly brown and puffed, about 15 minutes. Turn each straw over and bake an additional 5 - 7 minutes, until golden brown and crisp.
Prepare mussels in a white wine sauce per package instructions and serve with cheese straws.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (454 g) pkg mussels in a white wine sauce
